question: Should OpenClaw remove the shipped fallback now and make `imsg` 0.11.1 a mandatory startup floor for existing iMessage users?
rationale: The change intentionally invalidates a persisted option and makes older but currently working installations fail closed, which is a product and upgrade-policy choice rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Accept the new floor after repair
options.body: Fix final doctor verification, add live split-send proof, and then require `imsg` 0.11.1 or newer.

options.title: Preserve the fallback temporarily
options.body: Keep the existing compatibility path through a defined deprecation or release transition window.

recommendation.title: Accept the new floor after repair
recommendation.body: Fix final doctor verification, add live split-send proof, and then require `imsg` 0.11.1 or newer.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision couples OpenClaw upgrade policy to the newly released upstream `imsg` contract.
